# NFL Daily — 2026-10-28 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- Colts traded G Quenton Nelson to the Seahawks and DT DeForest Buckner to the 49ers within a day of each other as the 2-5 team begins shedding veterans ahead of the Nov. 10 deadline. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50301125/colts-trade-de-deforest-buckner-49ers)
- Colts WR Josh Downs requested a trade out of Indianapolis as the rebuild continues. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50309159/source-wr-downs-requests-trade-rb-taylor-per-coach)
- Chiefs signed free-agent K Justin Tucker, out of the league since 2025 sexual-misconduct allegations, to their practice squad after Harrison Butker's struggles. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50307506/sources-chiefs-sign-justin-tucker-practice-squad)
- Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) practiced for a fourth straight day, raising hopes he returns Sunday after missing three games. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50299565/inside-complicated-injury-history-ravens-lamar-jackson)

## Transactions
- Colts traded DT DeForest Buckner to the 49ers for a 2027 fourth-round pick. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50301125/colts-trade-de-deforest-buckner-49ers)
- Colts traded G Quenton Nelson to the Seahawks. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50043542/2026-trade-deadline-grades-latest-best-worst-deals)

## Injuries
- Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) was back on the practice field Wednesday for a fourth straight day, the clearest sign yet he returns Sunday after missing three starts. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)

# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-10-28 (Past 1 day)

## Key news
- QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) practiced for a fourth straight day, the strongest sign yet he could return Sunday at Buffalo after missing three games. [Baltimore Sun](https://www.baltimoresun.com/2026/10/28/ravens-lamar-jackson-practice-status-bills/)
- S Kyle Hamilton left Wednesday's practice wearing a brace on his right knee and didn't return; LB Roquan Smith and S Jaylinn Hawkins were also held out, thinning the secondary ahead of Buffalo. [Zrebiec](https://x.com/jeffzrebiec/status/2115519218578030941)
- G Vega Ioane (knee, MCL sprain) remains out; coach Jesse Minter called right guard an open competition between Andrew Vorhees and Emery Jones Jr. if Ioane can't return soon. [Shaffer](https://x.com/jonas_shaffer/status/2115520648596640005)
- Ravens claimed G Christian Haynes off waivers after Seattle released him once it traded for Quenton Nelson, adding offensive-line depth. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2115541451031355872)
- Team leaders, including Ronnie Stanley and Derrick Henry, said the Ravens' sideline energy and communication need to change after a second straight AFC North loss, to Cincinnati. [Hensley](https://x.com/jamisonhensley/status/2115471143285223692)

- Chiefs signed free-agent K Justin Tucker, out of the league since 2025 sexual-misconduct allegations, to their practice squad after Harrison Butker's struggles; coach Andy Reid said Tucker "took care of" his suspension. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50307506/sources-chiefs-sign-justin-tucker-practice-squad)

- _No qualifying transactions in this window._

## Injuries
- Bengals WR Ja'Marr Chase (ankle) was held out of Wednesday's practice and is questionable for Sunday. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Bengals TE Erick All Jr. will need season-ending surgery after tearing his ACL for a third time. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Bills WR DJ Moore (shoulder) has missed the last two games and was back in a no-contact jersey Wednesday. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Bills S C.J. Gardner-Johnson remains on the reserve/suspended list. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
